description.value: Bluefin Sushi is a Japanese fusion restaurant in New Westminster's Columbia Street corridor, specializing in fresh sushi made from seafood, meat, and produce the kitchen describes as the finest available. The restaurant offers indoor seating and online ordering, making it a straightforward lunch or dinner stop for cyclists moving through the Lower Mainland.

address.value: 319 E Columbia St, New Westminster, BC V3L 3W8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Japanese fusion/sushi restaurant at 319 E Columbia St, New Westminster, matching the OSM address and primary phone number (604) 525-0105. The website features an 'Online Order' button confirming takeout availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. A minor phone discrepancy exists: the footer copyright block lists (604) 525-0108 while the main address block lists (604) 525-0105.
concerns: Website footer copyright block lists a different phone number (604) 525-0108 than the main address block (604) 525-0105), which matches OSM. Likely a typo on the site, but worth verifying.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sushi restaurant with a live website and confirmed address. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists on the New Westminster waterfront corridor.
